Game Overview

In 4Color Swipe, the core idea is straightforward: test your reflexes in 4Color Swipe, where quick thinking meets addictive gameplay. Guide a fast-approaching ball to its correct path using precise swipes. Challenges intensify with each level, demanding sharper focus and faster reactions.
